parts:
Write a function to extract the month end exchange rates from Problem 3.9.  Apply your function to get the month exchange rates from 12/31/2006 (or thereabouts ) to 12/31/2007 (or thereabouts).

題目是說寫一個function 抓出excel檔的資料 

只要每個月的最後一天

我寫出function只完成了 1.轉換日期格式成yyyymmdd   2.抓出起始日和最後一天的資料

第三步應該是要抓出區間內每個月的最後一天資料

get.endmonth <- function( firstDate, lastDate)
{
    DEXUSUK <- read.csv("DEXUSUK.csv", skip=12, colClasses=c("character", "numeric"))
    years <- as.numeric(substr(DEXUSUK$DATE,1,4))
    months <- as.numeric(substr(DEXUSUK$DATE,6,7))
    days <- as.numeric(substr(DEXUSUK$DATE,9,10))
    yearsmonthsdays <- 10000*years + 100*months + days
    DEXUSUK$DATE <- yearsmonthsdays
    alldates <- DEXUSUK$DATE
    selectedDates <- alldates >= firstDate & alldates <= lastDate
    DEXUSUK[selectedDates,]
}

index <- rep(NA, 12)
for (i in seq_along(month.list)) {
  month <- month.list[i]
  index[i] <- tail(grep(month, data$DATE), 1)
}
